entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2102436351673656704: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.8323 +/- 0.0274 mas (same row, RUWE 1.03): 171.46 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -2.149, -13.853 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 2102436351673656704 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 60,000 of its distance per century.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.4 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Cañas et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KOI-4777.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163....3C/abstract). Mass 0.41 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Cañas et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KOI-4777.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163....3C/abstract). Temperature 3515 +/- 69 K from Cañas et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KOI-4777.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,515 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc78c. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,515 K and log g 4.85 (u1 0.391, u2 0.379): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
